value.text: After awaited Save returns normally, Places returns Ok(city), including this Place.Longitude value. Dashboard forwards the upstream status and parsed JSON without a response.ok check. The city-button handler checks HTTP success but does not read the returned Place fields; it displays "City saved; forecast pending" and then makes a separate weather read. Both a newly saved city and an existing city can return 200; this is not forecast or message-delivery completion. The separately bound declared HTTP 200 schema requires JSON.longitude; this is distinct from the event-envelope contract and does not prove runtime conformance.
